thread:
emily: Heads-up from sales: large enterprise asking for per-route reserved capacity specifically for embeddings + monthly burst. They want a 12mo commit and per-route billing lines.
ryan: Got it. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Hosted only or private too? 2) Are they expecting hard SLA or credits?
emily: They prefer hosted but will consider private if price delta is reasonable. They're asking for an SLA on reserved routes.
priya: Product quick take: propose a Route Capacity Pack (RCP) SKU. MVP scope: embeddings routes only, console toggle, per-route qps field, burst pool top-up. No gen/chat in MVP.
dave: Infra note: implementing per-route reservations requires scheduler + token-bucket accounting + soft-preemption logic. Estimate: 3 infra sprints + 2 for monitoring and fallback.
clara: Ops: we need a clear fallback path when reserved pool is exhausted: fallback to best-effort model variant + notify customer. Also need per-tenant burst metering dashboard.
sara-legal: Legal: don't call it a "guarantee". Recommend "commercially reasonable efforts" + defined credits formula (capped). Also 30d notice for cancellation.
priya: Launch acceptance checks (draft): 1) billing SKU + price bands; 2) console/API controls for per-route qps and burst; 3) routing + fallback policy implemented; 4) monitoring + burn metrics + runbook; 5) legal-approved contract language.
ryan: Sales wants three price points to pitch: Basic (no reserve), Team (reserved qps, no SLA), Enterprise (reserved qps + burst + SLA + premium support).
dave: Cost model stub: 20 qps embeddings -> ~14 GPU-hrs/day incremental -> ~$13k/mo infra + oncall overhead. Adding SLA buffer + support -> add ~2x margin for Enterprise.
emily: Negotiation levers to propose: cap monthly burst (e.g., 1M tokens), automatic fallback when exhausted, and insurance credit capped at X% of monthly fee.
priya: To shorten time, MVP restricts to quantized embedding configs and single model family. Rollout via 5-customer pilot.
ops-bot: created ticket PROD-5012: Route Capacity Pack (assignee: priya)
clara: Owners: priya (spec & console), dave (infra & monitoring), ryan (pricing), sara-legal (contract draft), emily (sales coordination).
emily: Weekly sync Thursday 11am PT. Anyone blocked?
ryan: I'll run sensitivity on utilization assumptions by EOD Friday.
sara-legal: Draft contract variants for Hosted vs Private by Monday.
dave: infra sprint plan in next update.
priya: ack, will draft spec this week.
emily: thanks all :thumbsup:
